name: io.github.odaiameera/scamgate
title: scamgate
description: Offline scam check for agents: verify links and payments before acting (allow, ask or deny).

environmentVariables.name: SCAMGATE_AUTO_UPDATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refresh the phishing lists every 6 hours while the server runs (off by default).

environmentVariables.name: SCAMGATE_URLHAUS_AUTH_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional abuse.ch Auth-Key that adds the URLhaus malware-link list.
